title: Bounded derived-complete complexes with finitely generated cohomology
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subset A$ an ideal, and $D(A)$ the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of $A$-modules, with cohomology modules $H^i(K)$. Define

$$
 D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(A,I)\subset D(A)
$$

to be the full subcategory of the objects $K$ satisfying all three conditions:

1. $K$ is bounded [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories], meaning $H^i(K)=0$ for all but finitely many $i\in\mathbf Z$.
2. Every $H^i(K)$ is a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module].
3. $K$ is derived complete with respect to $I$ [def-weil-point-derived-complete-module-complex].

Here full subcategory means that, for two such objects $K,L$, its morphisms from $K$ to $L$ are exactly $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(A)}(K,L)$, with identities and composition inherited from $D(A)$.

For a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and chosen uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], write $D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(\mathcal O_E)=D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(\mathcal O_E,(\varpi_E))$.
